message.content:
The largest planet that astronomers have confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young B‑type star HD 100546 and has a radius roughly **2.7 × the radius of Jupiter** (about 30,000 km). This makes it the biggest planet ever detected, though it’s still a few million years old and likely still accreting material from its surrounding disk.
